test_overview: Evaluation began successfully: the server was accessible at http://localhost:8000, and login as the seeded technician (Liam Johnson, tech.liam.rfp1@example.com) worked with a visible 'Welcome back!' toast and the technician navigation (Bookings, Jobs, Invoices, RFPs, Vendors, POs). However, Step 1's first action — 'Navigate to RFPs and create a new RFP' — could not be performed: clicking the 'RFPs' nav link (data-testid=nav-rfps, visible and clicked twice with waits) left the app on the 'All Service Bookings' view. The RFP list/creation UI never renders (the Vendors and POs views exhibit the same behavior; inspection of the served frontend shows renderRFPs/renderRFPDetail are referenced by the router but not defined in the served app.js). This is a fatal action failure: none of the RFP functionality required by the test plan (creation, attachments, status transitions, outcome setting, job creation from awarded RFP, deletion, list filters) is reachable through the UI. Per the fatal-failure rule, the evaluation was stopped and all remaining steps were recorded as not executed with 0 points. Total score: 0/19.

steps.description: Step 1 test_create_rfp_with_attachments: FATAL FAILURE. Login succeeded, but clicking the 'RFPs' nav link did not navigate — the page remained on 'All Service Bookings'; the RFP creation UI is unreachable, so none of the actions (create RFP, upload attachments, verify Draft status / max-5 / PDF-only rules) could be performed. Step failed fatally, terminating the test plan.
Step 2 test_status_transitions_to_submitted: NOT EXECUTED. Depends on an RFP created in Step 1 and the RFP detail UI, which is unreachable due to the fatal failure in Step 1.
Step 3 test_awarded_and_job_creation: NOT EXECUTED. Depends on the RFP detail / Submitted RFP / Create Job UI, all unreachable due to the fatal failure in Step 1.
Step 4 test_lost_outcome_terminal: NOT EXECUTED. Requires creating an RFP and using the RFP detail UI, which do not render (fatal failure in Step 1).
Step 5 test_rfp_deletion_rules: NOT EXECUTED. Requires RFP/Vendor/PO UIs to create Draft RFPs, a vendor, and a PO; none of these views render (fatal failure in Step 1).
Step 6 test_rfp_list_filters: NOT EXECUTED. The RFP list view never renders, so sort order, columns, and filters could not be verified (fatal failure in Step 1).
